description: Source code implementing socket operations for TI SimpleLink Wi-Fi driver in Zephyr OS, including socket creation, binding, connecting, accepting, polling, and TLS credential handling.

methods.name: getErrno
methods.description: Converts SL error codes into BSD errno values.

methods.name: simplelink_socket_family_from_posix
methods.description: Maps POSIX socket family to SimpleLink family.

methods.name: simplelink_socket_type_from_posix
methods.description: Maps POSIX socket type to SimpleLink socket type.

methods.name: simplelink_socket_proto_from_zephyr
methods.description: Maps Zephyr IP protocol to SimpleLink protocol.

methods.name: simplelink_socket
methods.description: Creates a socket with mapped family, type, and protocol.

methods.name: simplelink_close
methods.description: Closes a socket object.

methods.name: translate_z_to_sl_addrlen
methods.description: Translates Zephyr sockaddr to SimpleLink sockaddr.

methods.name: translate_z_to_sl_addrs
methods.description: Converts Zephyr sockaddr to SimpleLink sockaddr.

methods.name: translate_sl_to_z_addr
methods.description: Converts SimpleLink sockaddr to Zephyr sockaddr.

methods.name: simplelink_accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, translating sockaddr formats.

methods.name: simplelink_bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to an address, translating sockaddr formats.

methods.name: simplelink_listen
methods.description: Listens for incoming connections.

methods.name: simplelink_connect
methods.description: Connects a socket to a remote address, with certificate validation handling.

methods.name: simplelink_poll
methods.description: Polls multiple sockets for events using select.

methods.name: map_credentials
methods.description: Maps Zephyr TLS credentials to SimpleLink socket options.

methods.name: simplelink_setsockopt
methods.description: Sets socket options, including TLS credentials and domain verification.

methods.name: simplelink_getsockopt
methods.description: Gets socket options, including TLS and socket states.

methods.name: handle_recv_flags
methods.description: Emulates MSG_DONTWAIT behavior for recv using socket options.

methods.name: simplelink_recvfrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, handling address translation.

methods.name: simplelink_sendto
methods.description: Sends data to a socket, translating address formats.

methods.name: simplelink_sendmsg
methods.description: Stub for sendmsg, not supported.

methods.name: set_addr_info
methods.description: Creates addrinfo list from SimpleLink address info.

methods.name: simplelink_getaddrinfo
methods.description: Resolves hostname to address info using SimpleLink utilities.

methods.name: simplelink_freeaddrinfo
methods.description: Frees addrinfo list.

methods.name: simplelink_fcntl
methods.description: Handles fcntl commands for socket flags.

methods.name: simplelink_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands, including poll and offload.

methods.name: simplelink_read
methods.description: Reads data from socket.

methods.name: simplelink_write
methods.description: Writes data to socket.
